says: A renewed knock's answer that arrives after client.granted sends the Link not_granted from dialing back to waiting_grant, and the admission that follows is dropped, so the window shows a waiting code and opens no tile while the door holds it online, until the socket drops.
proof: Scratch walk on the real machine (scratchpad p18/walk.ts deadend, run with node 26 from the p18s1 worktree) printed 'granted | link dialing | hs initializing h1.3', then 'late renew answer | link waiting_grant code K7Q3', then 'admitted | link waiting_grant ... | hs admitted'. Link.ts:153-156 admits only from dialing; Gateway.ts:649-680 still answers a knock with a code while the attachment is waiting, which lasts until the new initialize.
cost: A person granted during a renew round trip is stuck on the waiting screen with a stale code and a wrong 'waiting' connect row; P19's Electron client and the MCP bridge inherit it.
